summary: Iteration 4 — real Glitz data import (3 events), interactive floor plan, /api/club-info, centered GLITZ logo. Backend: 13/13 pytest passed. GET /api/events returns exactly ev-damante, ev-giada, ev-raul with 2027 dates and covers at https://glitz-nightclub.preview.emergentagent.com/events/*.png; GET /api/events/{id} works for all three and 404 for unknown. GET /api/tables/zones returns 8 tables each with x,y ∈ [0,100], area, seats, price, bottles, available; z-arco-2 is unavailable, z-riva-1 is available. GET /api/club-info returns name='GLITZ CLUB', address contains 'San Nicola Arcella', instagram='glitzclubofficial', 4 areas. POST /api/tickets for ev-damante mints a GLITZ- code (price €25), it appears in GET /api/tickets and is surfaced as next_ticket by /api/my-night. POST /api/waiter-calls and POST /api/orders both require Bearer (401 without) and succeed with a real table zone. Frontend (390x844): registered a fresh iter4_<uuid>@glitz.test user, reached serata-screen. LogoHeader (centered GLITZ) renders on both Serata (1 instance) and Ordina (2 instances because tabs stay mounted). Event cards event-ev-damante / event-ev-giada / event-ev-raul all rendered. Ordina: FloorPlan renders all 8 plan-table-* testIDs; tapping plan-table-z-riva-1 shows banner 'Sei al RIVA 1 · Riva Deck'; tapping waiter-acqua creates a call row 'Acqua · RIVA 1 · INVIATA'; two plus-m-01 taps show cart-bar '2 articoli · RIVA 1 · €24.00'; submit-order posts and I MIEI ORDINI shows '2× Glitz Spritz · €24 · RIVA 1 · RICEVUTO'. Zone name RIVA 1 correctly propagates from the piantina into both the waiter call and the order. Deprecated packages detected: NONE. ISSUE: event cover images are blocked on web preview — upstream https://glitz-nightclub.preview.emergentagent.com/events/*.png returns 'cross-origin-resource-policy: same-origin', so all 3 covers fail to load (console: ERR_BLOCKED_BY_RESPONSE.NotSameOrigin ×3) and the event cards render with an empty/black cover area on Serata.

ui_bugs.issue: The 3 real event covers hosted at https://glitz-nightclub.preview.emergentagent.com/events/*.png set the response header 'cross-origin-resource-policy: same-origin'. Chromium (web preview) blocks them (ERR_BLOCKED_BY_RESPONSE.NotSameOrigin), so event cards show a blank/dark cover area. Native builds using expo-image may still render fine, but web preview is broken.

issues: Pre-existing 'shadow*' style-prop deprecation warning from RN Web — cosmetic, unchanged since iter 2.

action_items: Fix event cover blocking on web: either (a) copy the 3 PNGs into /app/frontend/assets/images/ and require() them locally, (b) proxy them through the FastAPI backend (which does not set CORP: same-origin), or (c) upload them to storage without the same-origin CORP header. Update SEED_EVENTS[*].cover in /app/backend/club.py accordingly.

(Minor) The waiter-* Pressables use disabled={needTable}; on RN-Web this correctly prevents onPress but is_disabled() in Playwright still returns False. Optional: also apply aria-disabled or wrap in a View pointerEvents='none' so automated tools see the state. Functionally the gating already works (verified by clicking before selecting: no call was posted).
critical_code_review_comments: club.py: seed_club() upserts on startup so updated real event data always applies; list_events filters to SEED_EVENT_IDS which guarantees exactly the 3 real events regardless of legacy DB rows — good.
club.py: SEED_ZONES enriched with x,y ∈ [0,100] used by the FloorPlan absolute positioning — matches the frontend rendering.
club.py: new /api/club-info is auth-gated like the rest; response shape {club: {...}} is consistent with events/tickets.
ordina.tsx: table state is single source of truth; zone = table?.name flows into both waiter-calls and orders payload; buttons visually dimmed via styles.disabled when needTable=true.
floor-plan.tsx: absolute positioning with left/top as % and marginLeft/-Top for centering — clean and simple.
index.tsx: Serata renders LogoHeader at top; events carousel uses ev.cover directly — will break on web if cover origin sets CORP: same-origin (see UI bug).
seed_data_creation: Fresh test user per run: iter4_<uuid>@glitz.test / secret1. One ticket for ev-damante purchased, one waiter-call and one order created per run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend seed IDs are ev-damante, ev-giada, ev-raul. Table IDs on the floor plan: z-back-1, z-arco-1, z-arco-2 (unavailable), z-riva-1..3, z-seat-1..2. Ordina flow requires tapping a plan-table before waiter-* buttons or submit-order will act. LogoHeader (testID=logo-header) is present on both Serata and Ordina; because Expo tabs stay mounted, use .first when the same testID exists on multiple tabs. Event covers currently blocked on web preview by upstream CORP header — until fixed, screenshots of Serata carousel will show black/blank cover areas.
rca_of_issue: Event cover blank on web = upstream server at glitz-nightclub.preview.emergentagent.com serves the PNGs with 'cross-origin-resource-policy: same-origin'. Repro: `curl -I https://glitz-nightclub.preview.emergentagent.com/events/opening-damante.png` returns 200 + `cross-origin-resource-policy: same-origin`. Browser then blocks the cross-origin load with ERR_BLOCKED_BY_RESPONSE.NotSameOrigin. Mitigation: host covers locally (bundle in /app/frontend/assets or serve via /api/files on the backend). Native platforms are unaffected because CORP is a browser-only policy.
